riverland-10.name: Rocky's Hall of Fame and Pioneers Museum
riverland-10.bio: Barmera museum with a 35 m guitar-shaped garden of handprints from over 190 country musicians.

notes.pin: Museum and guitar garden in Barmera; pin the museum entrance (council listing/Wikivoyage Barmera).
notes.cost: Council page and Weekend Notes say $2 per person; History SA lists a gold coin donation. Volunteer-run, irregular hours.

riverland-11.name: Waikerie Silo Art
riverland-11.bio: Double silo mural by two artists on a clifftop at Waikerie, almost 30 m tall.
riverland-11.ticket_note: No single official site; SATC listing only.

notes.pin: Silos on the clifftop in Waikerie, viewable from the adjacent car park; Australian Silo Art Trail location.

riverland-12.name: Waikerie Rotary Cliff Top Walk and Art Trail
riverland-12.bio: A 2 km clifftop walk from the ferry to lookouts over the Murray floodplain, past murals and sculptures.
riverland-12.ticket_note: No official page found; SATC listing only.

notes.pin: Linear walk (about 2 km) from the Waikerie ferry along the clifftop: pin the route midpoint (OSM way if present, else council trail map).

riverland-13.name: Gluepot Reserve
riverland-13.bio: Volunteer-run mallee reserve with a visitor centre, 14 walking trails and bird hides, home to the black-eared miner.

notes.pin: Visitor Centre at the homestead area (not the reserve centroid); self-registration there.
notes.fee: Day visitors $10 per vehicle per day, camping $20 per vehicle per night (gluepot.org/visit-us). Reserve was closed for track drying at fetch time.

riverland-14.name: Loch Luna and Moorook Game Reserves
riverland-14.bio: Floodplain wetlands near Kingston-on-Murray with canoe trails, birdlife and camping beside the Murray.

notes.pin: Visitor point: Loch Luna boat ramp/canoe launch or main campground off Kingston Bridge (NPWS map); not the reserve centroid.
notes.cost: Park page lists only accommodation ($15.40/night); no entry fee.

riverland-15.name: Danggali Conservation Park
riverland-15.bio: Remote mallee wilderness north of Renmark, home to malleefowl, with pastoral-relic walking trails.

notes.pin: Remote park: use the main visitor point (Thurk's Well/Old Hut area or park entry per NPWS map), not the centroid.
notes.cost: Free entry per park page. Park alert at fetch time: closed until further notice after heavy rain; closed on catastrophic fire days.

riverland-16.name: Possum Parade
riverland-16.bio: Brushtail possums come down the palm trunks at dusk on the Renmark riverfront to eat food left by visitors.
riverland-16.ticket_note: No operator; run informally on the riverfront (SATC listing, free, year-round).

notes.pin: Riverfront palms near the Renmark Visitor Information Centre, Murray Avenue (some possums also at Jarrett Memorial Gardens, James Avenue).

riverland-17.name: Renmark Rotary Lookout Tower
riverland-17.bio: Lookout tower in Renmark West with 360-degree views over farmland and the town, open day and night.
riverland-17.ticket_note: Council-run lookout with no dedicated page found.

notes.pin: Wikivoyage listing's own geo about -34.1463, 140.7087 (144 Chino St, Renmark West); confirm against OSM tower.

riverland-18.name: Renmark Paringa Community Museum
riverland-18.bio: Local history museum in Paringa with mostly agricultural and riverside displays of Renmark and Paringa.
riverland-18.ticket_note: No official site verified; SATC and BIG4 listings only.

notes.pin: 12 Sturt Hwy, Paringa; Wikivoyage listing geo about -34.1808, 140.7796.
notes.cost: Listed as free with a donation appreciated; open Mon, Wed, Fri 10am-3pm.

riverland-19.name: Loxton Tree Sculptures
riverland-19.bio: Sixteen chainsaw-carved tree sculptures along an easy walking trail in Loxton's conservation and heritage park.
riverland-19.ticket_note: Council-run; no dedicated page verified (SATC listing, free).

notes.pin: Walking trail inside Loxton's conservation and heritage park (near the Historic Village): pin the trail midpoint or main car park.

riverland-20.name: Bulyong Island
riverland-20.bio: Boat-access island section of Murray River National Park north of Paringa for paddling, wildlife and bush camping.

notes.pin: Access by water only from Murtho Forest Landing/Murtho Landing; pin the island's main camping/landing area per NPWS Bulyong Island map.
notes.cost: Murray River NP page lists only accommodation from $15.40/night, no entry fee.
notes.alerts: Parts of Murray River NP closed for environmental watering to Nov 2026 (Lock 4 section, not Bulyong specifically).

riverland-21.name: Border Cliffs
riverland-21.bio: Chowilla campground and the 3.4 km Customs House Wetland Walk beside the Murray at the Victorian border.

notes.pin: Border Cliffs campground (Chowilla Game Reserve); walk is a loop, so pin campground/trailhead per NPWS map.
notes.cost: Chowilla page lists only accommodation $15.40/night, no entry fee.
notes.alerts: Parts of Chowilla closed to 30 Nov 2026 (campsites 14-32 etc.) and Danggali/Chowilla Regional Reserve closure alert at fetch time.
